about_the_game:
Very Disco, Disco Very!

In zero-G, every push is eternal — so keep the groove in motion.

Very Disco, Disco Very! is a chaotic alien disco board game for 1–8 players.

Push, bump, and boogie your way across the floor to charge your Boogie Meter and unleash dazzling, game-changing effects.

For more cascading chained chaos, you decide each outcome with the 3S Card System:

Social Cards:  Sharing is caring.
Selfish Cards: Power yourself up.
Sadistic Cards: Sabotage your rivals.

Then comes the Three Phases of Party Chaos, each one more unpredictable and dangerous than the last.
Where rhythm spirals, the floor shifts, and the groove takes control

Three Phases of Party Chaos

Phase 1 — The Groove Awakens
The dance floor comes alive. Players strut, collide, and start building their rhythm.
Each move ripples outward. Every combo and every bump sets off chain reactions that raise the beat higher.

Phase 2 — The Floor Unfolds
Boundaries blur. Gravity wobbles. The floor refuses to stay still.
The groove feeds on itself as chaos multiplies and control slips away in the best possible way.

Phase 3 — The Disco Cascade
The energy peaks and everything explodes into rhythm-fueled madness.
Beams, beats, and unpredictable physics collide in a full-blown cosmic finale.
When the lights cut and the music stops, only the most in-sync will still be grooving.

Features

 1–8 Players: Local or online alien party madness.
 Disco Board Battles: Once you’re moving, you’re really moving.
 Boogie Meter System: Discover game changing disco powers.
 Custom Levels: Start your own arenas and absurd layouts.
 3S Card System: Social, Selfish, and Sadistic cards that twist the rules.
 Dynamic “Disco Time”: A total rhythmic meltdown.
 Social Disco Stats: Track your pushes, combos, eliminations, and groove rank.
 Online Multiplayer: Fast, lightweight, peer-to-peer chaos, no waiting, just instant party energy.
 Fast-Paced Turns: Hesitate, and the groove leaves you behind. The party waits for no one.

Wishlist It, Baby

Prepare for the most absurd alien disco boardgame in the galaxy
where dancing is mandatory, gravity is optional,
the beat never stops, and even space can’t escape the groove.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
